title: R6 v2 + R4 v2 + R2 v3: tol_scale, time_budget, причина остановки, старт от снимка, снимки по N
goal: API решателя по R6 v2: SolveOpts{threads, max_iters, tol_scale, time_budget, init, snapshot_at} → Solved{iters, stop, residuals, history, state, snapshots, timing}; модуль state.rs — снимок R4 v2 (чтение/запись); тёплый старт как в игре (R4 «Старт от снимка»); CLI — тонкая обёртка (--tol-scale, --time-budget, --init, --snap-at, --snap-dir, --save-state); R2 v3. При tol_scale = 1 и холодном старте итерации и поля побитно как сейчас.
scope: tools/research/air_cascade/picard_rs/src/solver.rs — только solve() (tol_scale, time_budget, причина остановки, снимки), инициализация от снимка рядом с init_background; ядра и outer_step не трогать
tools/research/air_cascade/picard_rs/README.md — раздел «API v2, снимки и тёплый старт (PR-5)»
dont_touch: tools/research/air_cascade/picard_rs/out/ (результаты замеров — не в этой задаче)

accept.name: clippy
accept.cmd: .dpcli/dpcli lock cpu PR-5 --no-tmux -- cargo clippy --manifest-path tools/research/air_cascade/picard_rs/Cargo.toml --all-targets -- -D warnings

accept.name: blocks_dev
accept.cmd: .dpcli/dpcli lock cpu PR-5 --no-tmux -- cargo run -q --manifest-path tools/research/air_cascade/picard_rs/Cargo.toml -- blocks tests/atmosphere/fixtures/air_model/ref/flat_wind.json tests/atmosphere/fixtures/air_model/ref/agnesi.json tests/atmosphere/fixtures/air_model/ref/heated_slope.json tests/atmosphere/fixtures/air_model/ref/saddle.json

accept.name: solve_ref_release
accept.cmd: .dpcli/dpcli lock cpu PR-5 --no-tmux -- bash -c 'set -e; for c in flat_wind agnesi heated_slope saddle; do tools/research/air_cascade/picard_rs/target/release/picard solve tests/atmosphere/fixtures/air_model/ref/$c.json --threads 8 --out tools/research/air_cascade/picard_rs/target/check_${c}_release_t8.json; done' && python3 tools/research/air_cascade/picard_rs/contract/tolerance.py tools/research/air_cascade/picard_rs/target/check_flat_wind_release_t8.json tools/research/air_cascade/picard_rs/target/check_agnesi_release_t8.json tools/research/air_cascade/picard_rs/target/check_heated_slope_release_t8.json tools/research/air_cascade/picard_rs/target/check_saddle_release_t8.json

accept.name: solve_ongudai_release
accept.cmd: .dpcli/dpcli lock cpu PR-5 --no-tmux -- bash -c 'set -e; for c in ongudai_d400_u3_heat ongudai_d400_u3_mech ongudai_d400_u0_heat ongudai_d400_u6_heat; do tools/research/air_cascade/picard_rs/target/release/picard solve ~/data/air_cascade/ongudai/$c.json --threads 8 --out tools/research/air_cascade/picard_rs/target/check_${c}_release_t8.json; done' && python3 tools/research/air_cascade/picard_rs/contract/tolerance.py --iters-tol 10 tools/research/air_cascade/picard_rs/target/check_ongudai_d400_u3_heat_release_t8.json tools/research/air_cascade/picard_rs/target/check_ongudai_d400_u3_mech_release_t8.json tools/research/air_cascade/picard_rs/target/check_ongudai_d400_u0_heat_release_t8.json tools/research/air_cascade/picard_rs/target/check_ongudai_d400_u6_heat_release_t8.json

accept.name: test_api_state
accept.cmd: .dpcli/dpcli lock cpu PR-5 --no-tmux -- cargo test --manifest-path tools/research/air_cascade/picard_rs/Cargo.toml --test api --test state

accept.name: save_and_snap
accept.cmd: mkdir -p ~/data/air_cascade/picard_rs/states/check && .dpcli/dpcli lock cpu PR-5 --no-tmux -- tools/research/air_cascade/picard_rs/target/release/picard solve ~/data/air_cascade/ongudai/ongudai_d400_u3_heat.json --threads 8 --snap-at 30,100 --snap-dir ~/data/air_cascade/picard_rs/states/check --save-state ~/data/air_cascade/picard_rs/states/check/u3_heat_final.json --out tools/research/air_cascade/picard_rs/target/check_u3_heat_v3.json && python3 tools/research/air_cascade/picard_rs/contract/check_contract.py --state ~/data/air_cascade/picard_rs/states/check/u3_heat_final.json ~/data/air_cascade/picard_rs/states/check/*it30*.json ~/data/air_cascade/picard_rs/states/check/*it100*.json && python3 -c "import json; d=json.load(open('tools/research/air_cascade/picard_rs/target/check_u3_heat_v3.json')); print('v', d['version'], 'stop', d['stop'], 'snaps', len(d['snapshots']))"

accept.name: warm_same_case
accept.cmd: .dpcli/dpcli lock cpu PR-5 --no-tmux -- tools/research/air_cascade/picard_rs/target/release/picard solve ~/data/air_cascade/ongudai/ongudai_d400_u3_heat.json --threads 8 --init ~/data/air_cascade/picard_rs/states/check/u3_heat_final.json --out tools/research/air_cascade/picard_rs/target/check_u3_heat_warm.json && python3 -c "import json; d=json.load(open('tools/research/air_cascade/picard_rs/target/check_u3_heat_warm.json')); print('iters=%d' % d['iters'], d['stop'])"

accept.name: time_budget
accept.cmd: .dpcli/dpcli lock cpu PR-5 --no-tmux -- tools/research/air_cascade/picard_rs/target/release/picard solve ~/data/air_cascade/ongudai/ongudai_d400_u3_heat.json --threads 8 --time-budget 2 --out tools/research/air_cascade/picard_rs/target/check_u3_heat_tb.json && python3 -c "import json; d=json.load(open('tools/research/air_cascade/picard_rs/target/check_u3_heat_tb.json')); print(d['stop'], 'iters=%d' % d['iters'])"
